name: The Test of Righteousness
summary: In Cathedral Square, Duthorian Rall sends you to Ironforge with news for Jordan Stilwell. His wife Daphne survived the Defias attack in Westfall.

sections.title: A Messenger of Good News
sections.body: You guarded Daphne Stilwell at her Westfall homestead when Defias outlaws attacked, and she survived. Her husband had left for Ironforge, fearing his family was in danger. Now Rall sends you to tell Jordan in person, so he can learn what happened to Daphne.

sections.title: The Smith of Dun Morogh
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell once hoped to join the paladins, but chose his father's craft and became a master weaponsmith. He works at an anvil outside Ironforge's gates, holding fast to his faith as he shapes weapons. When you tell him Daphne survived, gratitude moves him to help you forge a blessed weapon of righteousness.

faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell is a devout weaponsmith who works outside Ironforge's gates. He once studied the ways of the Light alongside paladins, then chose his father's craft.

faq.q: Why was Jordan's wife in danger?
faq.answer: Daphne Stilwell lives on a farmstead in Westfall, where Defias Brotherhood outlaws threaten the people. Jordan feared an attack when he left for Ironforge. Bandits stormed the farm, but paladin initiates drove them off.

faq.q: Where can Jordan Stilwell be found?
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell works outside Ironforge's main gates in Dun Morogh. He prefers the mountain air to the Great Forge inside the city.

faq.q: Why does Duthorian Rall send the player to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall sends you to tell Jordan that Daphne survived the Defias attack. The journey brings you to a master smith who can guide you in making a sacred paladin weapon.

faq.q: What comes after speaking with Jordan?
faq.answer: After hearing the news, Jordan offers to help you forge a holy warhammer. He asks you to gather rare materials and sanctified relics from distant lands.

faq.q: How does Jordan feel about the Defias threat?
faq.answer: Jordan is angered by Stormwind's council and its neglect. The Defias Brotherhood has plagued Westfall for a long time. He hopes attacks on honest homesteads will force the boy-king's regents to face the crisis.

angles.text: As a paladin, you pass from protecting the weak to crafting sacred tools for purging evil across Alliance lands.
As an Alliance member, you see Westfall's common folk struggle against the Defias while royal advisors in Stormwind delay action.
As a blacksmith, you see Jordan's devotion in his work at the anvil, as surely as in a consecrated blade wielded in battle.
